# Month Year

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/date/month-year` (default export). A month in a specific year as `{ value: 'YYYY-MM' }` (statements, billing periods).

## Usage
```ts
import MonthYearField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/date/month-year';
```

The contained example shows the serialized shape.
